name: Team Squirtle: Bulky Balance & Early Fusion Defense
archetype: High physical defense, early status powders, and Water/Fighting core for complete gym domination.
gym_duel_rationale: Brock enforces a strict 2v2 duel. Enter the arena with Squirtle (4x super-effective Water Gun) and Mankey/Spearow (weight-scaled Low Kick to crush Onix). Bench electric and bug fusions to avoid Rock Tomb.

roster.progression_notes: Water Gun easily defeats Brock's Rock/Ground lineup. Withdraw boosts already formidable 65 Defense. Fuses with Tangela in Chapter 2 for unmatched Water/Grass bulk.
Fused from Route 22 catches. Low Kick scales off Onix's 210 kg weight, dealing massive 4x damage.
Caught in Viridian Forest. Nasty Plot doubles Special Attack while Charm halves enemy physical attack. Evolves into Pikachu at Lv. 15 in Chapter 2, then fuses with Kadabra.
Compound Eyes Sleep Powder guarantees early captures and disables tough wild encounters.

flex_bench.why_use: Route 22 catch. Learns Double Kick at Lv. 12, giving vital Fighting-type coverage against Onix and Geodude.
Route 1 catch with Keen Eye, Gust, and Quick Attack.

active_fusions: Mankey/Spearow (Early Fighting/Flying speed breaker and Brock duelist)
Butterfree/Beedrill (Bug/Poison status duo with 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Retain Mankey/Spearow through Mt. Moon for high-speed Fighting coverage.
2. In Chapter 2, purchase Super Splicers at Cerulean Poké Mart ($300 at any Mart) to fuse Wartortle with Route 1 Tangela.
upcoming_fusions: Wartortle/Tangela (Monstrous Water/Grass defensive wall with 103 Def in Chapter 2)
Kadabra/Pikachu (Fast Electric/Psychic special sweeper in Chapter 2)
